title: 'Magnificent Seven' pioneers reunite for historic PMA installation

blocks.text: FORT DEL PILAR, Baguio City — The installation of the Philippine Military Academy’s first female Commandant of Cadets on Saturday, Oct.17, was a reunion of many of the pioneering women who were the country’s very first female cadets, and the men, now part of the military brass, who welcomed them to the Corps of Cadets in 1993. In a ceremonial turnover rite with top military officials from Kalasag-Lahi Class of 1997, Army Colonel and Brigadier General-designate Leah Lorenzo-Santiago assumed the top job at the PMA Headquarters Tactics Group and commandant of cadets, giving her control over all cadet training activities.
